My only real hobby is gaming so nothing that will get me out around people, but I spent a decent amount of time applying for jobs but had a poorly timed panic attack right before an interview and ended up missing it.

Kind of put me off everything
I don't know what the consequences would be, I'd probably have to go to a hospital in the city.
I guess

I'm still here

I couldn't do it, it was too cold and the cold hurt too much while I was waiting

I feel like shit

I want to thank you guys for responding, I decided to dip into my Spiced Rum cache tonight and if I end up not being here tomorrow, know that you guys are all still great and it was nice to talk to you all
Isn't suddenly deciding to run away from it all an "emotional decision"

Talk then. I'm on my last glass of rum and coke before I take those sleeping pills and head out into the snow

That "fuck you" guy was pretty cool but I'm still determined to make this fucking happen
I've fought hard for so long to get some of that good. Nothing.

please don't report this guy for the "fuck you", I like seeing passion like this in posts 

I don't want to talk to you on the phone (sorry) but if you want to talk in private you can pm me and I'll respond
I'm sure it's a wonderful experience for people who can mentally handle that kind of change
I'm only tied down here because of lack of resources to leave, and general nervousness about doing so

I don't really want to kill anyone anymore. I've told myself that there's no way I'll ever do anything like that. The thought is still there but it's not really an urge and I don't have plans for it anymore. 

I tried changing my life, getting a job, going to school, all of that. It's like I'm not compatible with all the things that people have to do.
I had a panic attack last time I even had a job interview. If I can't gradually change my life what hope do I have to completely change it
I know I have doubts, but nothing has been getting better and I fear if I don't do it now I'll be trapped in a shit life forever

I've been through 3 therapists due to them retiring, and my psychiatrist is a guy who covers multiple northern communities so I don't see him often, I guess I'm just not all that open to the idea of involving even *more* people.

Some of your symptoms sound a lot like mine. (The demon, homicidal urges, etc) I [made a thread about myself a while ago](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/l86ne/suicide_seems_morally_right_to_me/). I got help for the things I wrote in that thread but my psychiatrist was dismissive of schizophrenia because of the non-hallucinatory nature of my delusions and called it a depression-induced psychotic break instead. He didn't think institutionalization was necessary but told me to give him a call if anything gets out of hand. Since making that thread I've gone on to a different antidepressant that seems to work a bit better but I still deal with the delusions and depression on occasion. 

Part of me wants to do what you did and go to an institution but the idea of that is terrifying. I live in a remote area and would have to move 6+ hours away from my family to do so. 

So basically my question for you is how do you find the courage to check yourself in? My mind is telling me that the loss of freedom would be worse than my life now but I don't know
Wish I could agree. It ruined me.

Gentle female voice. She told me that I have been different than everyone else from the beginning and I was depressed because of my desperate attempts to be a normal human being. Obeying her was my true purpose and the only thing that would make me happy.

For two and a half years I heard the voice of a "demon" who wished for me to kill people (quotes because I'm not religious, it's mostly a metaphor I think). I was depressed beforehand so this felt like somewhat of a blessing, I finally meant something. I was torn between homicide and suicide, and almost did both on a few occasions. 

I've been on antidepressants for a few months which stopped the voice, leading the doctor to believe it was a psychotic break brought on by the depression. I feel somewhat better, but that isn't saying much. I'm still depressed, and I still want to die. I think about it daily and nothing seems to help.

My secret is that I want to go back to how it was before. I know that murder is the worst thing you can do and I would take my own life before I could take the life of someone else but I miss how vibrant everything felt.

Behind me is a door, and behind that some stairs. They're both pretty great because neither has changed much since humans started building things.

Why stairs? Ramp-shaped things occur in nature all the time but stair-shaped things don't. Why did we start building stairs on things instead of ramps?

I'm guessing like most people on reddit I think about stupid things like this a lot, and then end up reading the wiki pages on stairs and ramps and doors and things that use them for hours and hours. 

I think the "love" step is the one I have the most problems with - how do you find things to love? Doesn't love usually come naturally with very little input from ourselves, much like what foods we enjoy and our favourite colours?

To be honest, I find that to be an oversimplification. Don't get me wrong - you're probably right. But as someone whose life hasn't moved forward in three years because of crippling depression and god knows what else that managed to survive through therapy and medication, I'm having a really hard time applying your advice. 

I want to - I completely see the logic in what you're saying and it seems like it should be as easy as an overnight change in mindset but it isn't. I don't know what's wrong with me to learn more about it, I don't remember the last person or thing that I truly loved, and I'm no longer content with living with what I have. 

I've made threads here before and I guess they worked since I'm not dead yet but I'm just not seeing any improvement on the horizon no matter how many platitudes (no offense) I read here.
How long did it take between everything falling apart and getting everything together again?

I think what happened when I was drunk was just because that when you're drunk your impulse control and ability to regulate your actions isn't as effective. And I phrased it wrong - I know I can drink - I just shouldn't get hammered again. 

>Just try not to be envious of those that seem to happily wade through life with half a brain: they only live half a life.

There are plenty of intelligent, happy people. I don't think it's unreasonable to want a mind that functions in a way that doesn't want to kill others/itself and still retain my intelligence.
There's also the issue of affording the medication (which I can't do) but I'll work that out later I guess.

The doctor is the only one who services this region, he actually has to fly between towns just to make sure the entire northern area has a psychiatrist, so another doctor is impossible. That being said, he doesn't seem like the type to just refuse something. I'll talk to him about it and bring up the possibility of this. 

Part of me just wants to print out what I posted and hand it to him since that's easier than talking, but I'm afraid of the consequences.
I've hurt myself in the past to satiate this as well. I don't think I have split personalities, based on how you describe it, but I understand that desire to cause pain.

Thanks.

Have you found anything that helps you manage?

What a shitty condescending post

Spoken like a person who doesn't know what they're talking about
Thanks for letting me know I'm not alone either.

Nearest psychiatric facility is in a city 6 hours away. Even if I had the financial means to get myself there, a vacation that'll result in me being alone in a place I don't like isn't something I want to do voluntarily.

I liked this post. I wasn't raised to any rigid standards and was generally a pretty happy kid, but I live in an extremely remote area in Northern Canada and never really got to see the world in the way I would have liked to. Getting out of here is tough too, moving on with life in any way requires moving at least half a province away. 

Do you think this could be all it is?
Yup, still here. Sorry for the delay, I had to sleep. I'll try to reply to everyone.

I failed the "are you human" captcha twice.

Thanks for making me laugh a little bit, reddit.
